_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the universal Anaplan product Pre-Sales journey template. Mirrors the Delivery Stage 2 three-block structure (A: positioning context, B: application mastery, C: persona-specific motion). Slots into the larger Pre-Sales template at stages[1].
_meta.foundational_workshop_note: General pre-sales methodology and general mock-presentation craft are taught in the Pre-Sales Workshop (one-day instructor-led course) delivered as part of the Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations prereq journey — completed once per PSE. This Stage 2 builds the TOPIC-SPECIFIC application of those general skills: discovery patterns specific to {{PRODUCT_NAME}}, demo flow and script for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}, light-config patterns for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}, competitive battlecards for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}.
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same three-block structure: A (positioning context), B (application mastery), C (persona-specific motion)
Self-serve digital scalable delivery model (instructor-led methodology training is foundational, not per-topic)
Same manager-info exit gate (manager contact required to exit Stage 2)
No comprehension check at Stage 2 exit — Stage 3 rubric-scored discovery + demo + light-config labs are the proof of mastery
Block A is persona-tailored to the Connected Planning narrative — PSEs must position the individual application within the broader enterprise story per user direction
Block B replaces methodology-phases content (Delivery-only) with PSE-relevant proof points: use cases, industry examples, client references
Block C replaces the methodology-phases webcast with a Demo + Discovery + Competitive track tailored to {{PRODUCT_NAME}}'s pre-built demo environment
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: PSE understands the application's value, the demo environment and canonical script, light-config patterns for client data (orgs, hierarchies, products), discovery patterns for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}, and the competitive landscape. They have practiced light config in passive walkthroughs but have NOT yet led a discovery + demo end-to-end against a mock customer. Stage 3 begins with rubric-scored discovery simulation, demo delivery, and light-config exercises in a provisioned sandbox of the pre-built demo environment. Verb shift: understand → practice.
open_items_parked_for_later: Per-product authoring spec — every Block A/B/C asset must be authored per product. Spec/template for each asset type to be defined as a separate work item.
Connected Planning context recording — single asset reused with per-topic framing; canonical version vs per-topic versions to be decided.
Application Overview (Pre-Sales) — does this share with Delivery's deeper Application Overview Academy course, or is it its own lighter PSE-flavored version? P7 inventory will answer.
Pre-built demo environment sandbox provisioning manifest — the per-PSE sandbox version of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} demo environment for Stage 3 lab access (separate per-product spec).
Asset reuse with Sales — Use Cases, Industry Examples, Client References, Connected Planning Context likely sharable across personas; Op Cmte / Single Content Policy decision.

name: Trained

The PSE has NOT yet led a discovery + demo end-to-end — that begins in Stage 3 mock-customer labs.

blocks.name: Connected Planning Context

blocks.name: Application Mastery
blocks.description: Cluster of complementary content — strategy, application overview, use cases, references — aimed at a PSE-grade understanding of what the application does and what value it delivers to the buyer.

blocks.description: Pre-built demo environment walkthrough, light-config patterns for client data, topic-specific discovery and requirement-mapping, and topic-specific technical battlecards.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} in the Connected Planning narrative
tasks.description: Short recording framing how {{PRODUCT_NAME}} fits into Anaplan's broader Connected Planning enterprise story. PSEs must be able to position the individual application AND elevate the conversation when multiple applications are in play (multi-application enterprise opportunities).

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} strategy & positioning (pre-sales lens)
tasks.description: Webcast framing why the application exists, who it's for, the business outcomes it delivers, and how it's positioned. Pre-sales-lens emphasis on translating buyer outcomes to demo flow and proof-points the PSE will surface during a customer demo.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Application Overview (Pre-Sales) Academy course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course providing a PSE-relevant overview of the application — what it does, what dashboards and outputs the buyer sees, how the application is structured (lists, hierarchies, modules at a navigational level), and what business questions it answers. Deeper than the Sales overview (PSEs need to demo the app); lighter than the Delivery overview (PSEs do not build models). Includes a short completion quiz.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} use cases & industry examples
tasks.description: Curated set of 5-7 use cases and industry exemplars showing how customers in different industries deploy {{PRODUCT_NAME}} and what business outcomes they achieve. PSEs absorb these as raw material for tailoring demos and discovery to the prospect's industry.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} client reference stories
tasks.description: Library of named client reference stories with attributable outcomes, customer quotes, implementation context, and reference-call protocol. PSEs learn the canonical references for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} and can weave them into demos and discovery conversations.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} demo environment & canonical demo script walkthrough
tasks.description: Recorded guided walkthrough of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-built demo environment AND the canonical demo script provided by Anaplan: navigation through the demo, the standard click-path, the talking points at each screen, and the sample data narrative. PSEs come out able to deliver the canonical demo from script.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Demo Environment & Demo Script Walkthrough recording

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} light-config patterns for client data
tasks.description: Recorded walkthrough of the canonical light-config patterns the PSE may apply during a customer demo: loading client organizations, hierarchies, product catalog entries, and other sample-data substitutions into the pre-built demo environment. Scope is explicitly LIGHT — no model building, no formula or list-structure changes. Pairs with the provisioned sandbox so PSEs can practice during Block C in preparation for Stage 3 rubric-scored exercises.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} discovery & customer requirement mapping
tasks.description: Topic-specific discovery question library (deeper than the Sales discovery guide — surfaces the technical signals a PSE needs) and the methodology for mapping a customer's requirements onto the pre-built {{PRODUCT_NAME}} application. Builds on the general discovery skills from the foundational Pre-Sales Workshop.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; asset content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} technical competitive battlecards & objection handling
tasks.description: Walkthrough of the technical-depth competitive battlecards for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}: top 3-5 competitors, technical differentiators (architecture, modeling approach, integration model), competitive demo positioning (what to show first, what to never show), and the top technical objections a PSE will face with canonical responses.

stage_actions.name: Provision per-PSE sandbox of {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-built demo environment
stage_actions.description: Automated provisioning of a per-PSE sandbox copy of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-built demo environment, used by the PSE for hands-on light-config practice in Block C and for Stage 3 rubric-scored discovery + demo + light-config exercises. The sandbox is product-scoped and role-scoped (Pre-Sales role).
stage_actions.trigger_rationale: Fires after Block B is complete (the last passive content task). The remaining Block C tasks (~3-4 hrs of demo/config/discovery walkthroughs) provide a buffer for provisioning to complete and any failures to be resolved before the PSE attempts hands-on practice.
stage_actions.verification_at_stage_3_entry: demo-sandbox-active gate verifies provisioning succeeded and the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} sandbox is accessible.
stage_actions._provisioning_manifest_status: TBD per product — the sandbox copy of the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-built demo environment must be defined as a separate per-product spec.
stage_actions._failure_handling_status: TBD — auto-ticket vs surfaced state vs both. Program-level decision.

_estimated_effort_total_note: Computed from task estimates. Heavier than Delivery and Sales Stage 2 because PSEs carry the BOTH the value/positioning content AND the demo/config/discovery prep — sales-equivalent + demo-equivalent in one stage. Per user direction: 'similar levels of advanced skills and experiences' justifies the deeper investment.
